chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Hilal, from Uqbah ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) in
a man who fell ill during the month of Ramadan, and when he recovered he wished to perform Hajj; what should he do regarding the making up of the fast? He said: When he returns, let him make it up.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing Hajj before making up missed Ramadan fasts if one is ill?
ai.summary: In this ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the priority of Hajj over the makeup of Ramadan fasts is established, reflecting the principle that the obligatory pillar of Hajj has a fixed time window, whereas fasting can be deferred. This highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that while both are obligatory, the temporal constraint of Hajj grants it precedence in execution order. The hadith is found in al-Istibsar, a key text for divergent opinions, underscoring the clarity of this specific legal precedent.
